Subject: Need help with a breach of contract case

Hello, my name is Girish Reddy. I am a 24-year-old software engineer living in Surat. Our company has a breach of contract claim of ₹16.2 crore against M/s Sathe Motors Ltd, and the goods supplied were defective. My case number is Com. S. No. 370/2022 in the Surat Commercial Court. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 84365 44457 or email girish.reddy@example.com.
